inclusions.text: Road permit (arranged by the operator, included in every tier)
inclusions.source: Road travel in this corridor requires a permit from local authorities, which is arranged by the operator and included in every tier.

The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, the mandatory road permit, and all driving and logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus entry to both temples); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (entrance fees plus a midday meal).

inclusions.text: Entry to both temples (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)

inclusions.text: Hotel pickup in Al-Gouna by guide and driver
inclusions.source: The day begins at your hotel in Al-Gouna, where your guide and driver will collect you in the morning.

exclusions.text: Entrance fees kept separate from the Base fare
exclusions.source: Egyptian entrance fees are revised often, so keeping them separate keeps the base fare honest.
